description: orchestrations-v1 plan files (.kete-orchestration/plan.json; docs/contracts/orchestrations-v1.md "Plan file"). Each file is `text` (encode as UTF-8) or `base64` (exact bytes). A valid file yields `proposal_send` (orchestrationPlanProposal with titles "send") and `proposal_omit` (titles "omit"); plan_digest is the SHA-256 of the file bytes, prompt_digest of each prompt in UTF-8. An invalid one is refused with `reason` (too_large, not_utf8, not_json, not_canonical, invalid). `reads` are readOrchestrationNodePrompt results against the first file.
